text: UW Health is the combined clinical enterprise of the University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics Authority (UWHCA), University of Wisconsin Medical Foundation, Inc., and their respective or jointly wholly-owned subsidiaries.
short: UW Health is the combined clinical enterprise of UWHCA and UW Medical Foundation

source.name: UWHCA Board of Directors Policy Manual (UW Health)
